## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.17.2.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.17.2.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.17.2.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.17.2.

## What's new

- **Every number checked.** All the numbers and worked examples in both
  manuals, the in-game Guide and the game's own text were checked against
  the rules. Corrections:
  - Official Statements restore 22 for Blue while its Trust holds, and 7 once
    it is lost (the card said 14);
  - a framed node takes 40% more from every push while it is framed, and the
    Frame-then-Plant combo gives a foothold rather than a capture on a
    well-held node;
  - a Watch Team cuts an attack's reach to a tenth (usually a grade or more),
    and a lost Trust multiplies the other side's reach by ten;
  - Show of Force pushes 24 on ACT and 20 on DECIDE; the income table, grade
    bands, crisis bands, area-loss rule and extra-move condition now say
    exactly what the game does;
  - the Practitioner's Manual's math pages add the terms they left out
    (support from neighbours, Bot Swarm's full-strength links, Donovia's
    Trust bonus) and use the same balance band as the campaign editor.
- **Fixes in the game.** A woken dormant narrative is described as hitting
  twice as hard, as it does. The debrief counts Donovia's nine capabilities.
  An opponent player's hover cards show their own odds of failure. Two
  screenshot captions now match their pictures.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.17 builds.
